caption: The drawing consists of several black ink line illustrations on a beige background, all contained within a rectangular border. On the left side, there are two vertical views of a tall hall clock, one a frontal view and the other a side view, each including decorative finials, a circular clock face with Roman numerals, and a long door on the main body. There are decorative arches above the door and a panel at the base. To the right, there are five boxed detailed illustrations: at the top is a fan-shaped motif labeled “Three Sevenths Actual Size,” below that on the left is a twist-shaped column ornament labeled “Half Actual Size,” and to its right are two rectangular sections labeled “Actual Size Template Showing Column,” featuring vertical fluting and a concave molding profile. The bottom right box displays two ornate pierced brass designs labeled “Pierced Brass Actual Size,” one marked “A” and the other “B,” with intricate scrollwork and leaf patterns. Handwritten notes and dimensions are visible beneath some images, including “SCALE 1/8,” “HALL CLOCK,” measurements, references to the Metropolitan Museum, and a signature in the lower left corner.
title: Clock Case
